verdict.rationale: JumpCloud advertises automated identity lifecycle management (creation, access changes, termination) and HRIS-driven onboarding/offboarding, which implies some provisioning automation, but no evidence pack item explicitly names SCIM, mentions pushing users/groups/entitlements into downstream SaaS apps, or references a SCIM connector catalog. missing for 10: explicit SCIM protocol documentation, list of SCIM-supported downstream apps, entitlement/group provisioning specifics, and independent confirmation of real-time push provisioning.
